# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.8 — AI Enhance that really enhances

## 🛠️ Fixed

### 🪄 Upscaling now always improves your video
- Before, if your video was already at the chosen resolution (for example 1080p → 1080p), the AI didn't run: the file came out in a few seconds, **unchanged**.
- Now **Upscaling always runs the AI**, even at the same size: it rebuilds detail, sharpens edges and removes compression blocks, then gives you the video at the size you chose.
- The default AI model is now **Best · real footage** (Real-ESRGAN x4plus), made for filmed video and photos. **Fast · animation** is still there for cartoons and anime.

### 🎛️ Only the settings that matter
- AI Enhance now shows **only the settings your files use**:
  - images: ×2 / ×3 / ×4 and the AI model;
  - videos in Upscaling: the resolution and the AI model;
  - videos in Interpolation: the frame rate only.
- No more frame-rate choice for a photo, or a resolution choice for an interpolation.

## ✨ Improved

### 🏷️ See the result before you start
- Each file shows what it will become: `1080p → 1080p · AI clean-up`, `25 → 60 fps`, `→ 2560×1704`.
- If a video is already at the frame rate you picked, it is flagged in orange so you can pick a higher one.

### ✅ Interpolation checked
- Interpolation was re-tested from 15 up to 240 fps: every in-between frame is a real new image, not a copy.

> Upscaling with the AI takes longer than a plain re-encode: count a few minutes for a one-minute video on a recent graphics card.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
